rules.text: Heroes only. Opponents can play only 1 Dragon
Ball on their turn.
Villains only. Opponents can play only 1
Dragon Ball on their turn. If Saibaimen is
anywhere in play, Heroes must keep their hands
face up during Combat.
Heroes only. POWER: End Combat. Banish after
use.
(Limit 1 per deck.) Villains only. POWER: If your
opponent's Main Personality is a Hero, your
opponent discards 4 life cards. Banish after use.
(Limit 1 per deck.) Heroes only. POWER: Place any
3 cards from your discard pile on the bottom of
your Life Deck. Banish after use.
Stop a physical or energy attack. Alternatively, if
Goku's Mixing Drill is in play: Energy attack
costing 2 stages. DAMAGE: 4 life cards. Banish
after use.
Piccolo only. POWER: Search your Life Deck for a
Dragon Ball whose number matches Piccolo's
current personality level and play it. Banish after
use.
Stop a physical attack. Stop all physical
attacks for the rest of this Combat. Banish after
use.
Villains only. POWER: Banish an Ally to end
Combat. Alternatively, if Saiyan Power Drill is in
play: Energy attack costing 2 stages. DAMAGE:
4 life cards.
Stop a physical attack. Your opponent takes 1
life card of damage.
POWER: Use when needed. Copy a Drill in play as
your floating effect until Combat ends, active only
during Attack Phases. If Black Shadow Drill is in
play, put all opposing Allies on the bottom of their
owners' Life Decks. Banish after use.
Physical attack. DAMAGE: AT stages. HIT: Stop
all energy attacks for the rest of this Combat.
POWER: Banish all Earth Dragon Balls in play and
in all Life Decks.
Heroes only. Energy attack costing 2 stages.
DAMAGE: 5 life cards. Main Personality powers
cannot stop this attack or prevent or reduce its
damage.
Heroes only. Energy attack costing 2 stages.
DAMAGE: 5 life cards, or 7 if Piccolo's Flight is in
play. Main Personality powers cannot stop this
attack or prevent or reduce its damage.
Heroes only. Stop the first physical attack next
Combat. Alternatively, if Chiaotzu's Drill is in play:
Energy attack costing 2 stages. DAMAGE: 4 life
cards. Banish after use.
POWER: Place the top 2 cards of your discard pile
on the bottom of your Life Deck.
POWER: All opponents discard their Allies in play.
Banish after use.
(Limit 1 per deck.) Heroes only. Use as a
defense. Stop a physical or energy attack and all
attacks for the rest of Combat. Banish after use,
or discard instead if any Dragon Ball 7 is in play.
(Limit 1 per deck.) Heroes only. POWER: Search
your Life Deck for a Dragon Ball and play it.
Banish after use.
POWER: Stop the effect of any non-Dragon Ball
card and banish that card. You may use this at
any time.
Heroes only. POWER: Banish an opponent's Setup
or Drill in play. Banish after use.
(Limit 1 per deck.) Physical attack. DAMAGE: 0
stages. HIT: Discard all your opponent's Drills in
play.
Energy attack costing 2 stages. DAMAGE: 6 life
cards.

artwork.mode: approved alternate rear-facing Goku with exact published artwork layer

rules.text: Stop an energy attack. Your opponent takes 3
stages of damage.
(Limit 1 per deck.) POWER: Your opponent cannot
win by Most Powerful Personality Victory or
Dragon Ball Victory until the end of their second
turn, starting now. Banish after use.
Physical attack. DAMAGE: AT stages. HIT: Deal
3 additional life cards of damage.
POWER: Randomly discard 1 card from your
opponent's hand.
(Limit 1 per deck.) Physical attack costing 1
life card. DAMAGE: AT stages. Lower your
opponent's anger to 0.
POWER: For each level you lower your anger,
lower all opponents' anger 1 level.
POWER: Set all players' anger to 3.
(Limit 1 per deck.) Stop an energy attack. Stop
all energy attacks for the rest of this Combat.
POWER: Search your discard pile for an Ally and
play it.
(Limit 1 per deck.) POWER: Place the top 3 cards
of your discard pile on the bottom of your Life
Deck.
Physical attack. DAMAGE: 5 stages. Do not use
the AT.
Stop a physical attack. Raise your anger 2
levels and gain 2 stages.
